cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no prominent strong anionic. Earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate #2 (mild anionic) with prominent amphoteric co-surfactants Lauramidopropyl Betaine #3 and Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4; Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate #5 is a second mild anionic -> low. Counter-signal toward moderate: two mild anionics and no refatting, recorded; the convention holds.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Formula as frozen: only Polyquaternium-10 #10 (after Parfum), no silicone, lipid, refatter or R11 humectant (Butylene Glycol #23 excluded) -> cleansing-led architecture with little substantive slip -> low. Confidence low because of the ID-3 material conflict: claimed jojoba/coconut/macadamia oils absent from INCI could, if present, add an emollient route and move the value to moderate.
